scope: Existing National Rail London stations with a supported TfL counterpart; no nearest-station guesses.
routingPolicy: Use a multi-stop hub to preserve all supported modes; a single-stop hub uses its stopId.

auditWindow.purpose: Coverage review only; includes some stations outside London.

BET.name: Bethnal Green
BET.note: National Rail Bethnal Green is the Weaver station, not the separate Central line station.

CTK.name: City Thameslink
CTK.note: Reviewed adjacent interchange via Blackfriars, using the National Rail ALF CTK–BFR WALK allowance of 5 minutes.
CTK.accessNote: Walk between City Thameslink and Blackfriars Underground; 5 minutes of walking is included in the station transfer allowance.
CTK.source: National Rail RJTTF939ALF.txt: M=WALK,O=CTK,D=BFR,T=5 (weekday and Sunday records)

FST.name: London Fenchurch Street
FST.note: Reviewed adjacent interchange: c2c identifies Tower Hill as approximately 3 minutes on foot from Fenchurch Street.
FST.accessNote: Walk between Fenchurch Street and Tower Hill Underground; 3 minutes of walking is included in the station transfer allowance.

HAF.name: Heathrow Terminal 4 Rail
HAF.note: Heathrow Terminal 4 Rail shares the Terminal 4 transport interchange.

HWV.name: Heathrow Terminal 5 Rail
HWV.note: Heathrow Terminal 5 Rail shares the Terminal 5 transport interchange.

HXX.name: Heathrow Terminals 1-2-3 Rail
HXX.note: The legacy National Rail Terminals 1-2-3 name identifies the current Terminals 2 & 3 interchange.

KGX.name: London Kings Cross
KGX.note: King’s Cross mainline station accesses the shared King’s Cross St Pancras Underground station.

NWX.name: New Cross
NWX.note: New Cross ELL is the Windrush service at New Cross National Rail station.

SQE.name: Surrey Quays
SQE.note: Exact station identity reviewed: National Rail catalogue longitude has the wrong sign; do not use it for proximity matching.

STP.name: London St Pancras International
STP.note: St Pancras accesses the shared King’s Cross St Pancras Underground station. National Rail walks to King’s Cross remain walks.

WAE.name: London Waterloo East
WAE.note: Southeastern confirms a direct Waterloo East entrance from Southwark Underground; retain the station interchange allowance.
WAE.accessNote: Use the direct interchange between Waterloo East and Southwark Underground; this route involves steps or an escalator.

unmapped.name: West Hampstead Thameslink
unmapped.reason: West Hampstead Thameslink is separate from the Underground/Overground entrances; preserve National Rail walking links.
